what: GPU (web/shaders/film/gpu.mjs) against the CPU reference (web/shaders/film/run.mjs) for the spectral film shader
compare: 8-bit sRGB from the display encode (encodeFilm8 / ENCODE_FILM8_WGSL), per channel, all pixels
